title: [react-instantsearch-nextjs] relax next.js peer dependency range to support v16
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

currently, `react-instantsearch-nextjs` does not allow next.js v16 in its peer dependency range:

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/7cc565086f06a9ec74155002c26596b68efc53bc/packages/react-instantsearch-nextjs/package.json#L70

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

in a next.js v16 project run `pnpm add react-instantsearch-nextjs`

### Live reproduction

n/a

### 💭 Expected behavior

no peer dependency error when installing with pnpm
